description.value:
Granted by the sectioned rune. The weapon has separated into linked segments joined by fine chain.

The weapon gains the reach trait. You take a −2 circumstance penalty to Strikes against adjacent creatures (applied automatically when a target is within 5 feet). When you critically hit with the unfolded weapon, the target takes 1d4 persistent bleed damage.

Refolding the weapon is an Interact action — delete this effect, or use the Sectioned: Unfold / Refold macro.

Your sectioned weapon separates into linked segments joined by fine chain, or draws back together into a single solid weapon.

Effect Toggle the Effect: Sectioned (Unfolded) effect on yourself. While unfolded, the weapon gains the reach trait, you take a −2 circumstance penalty to Strikes against adjacent creatures, and critical hits deal 1d4 persistent bleed damage.

description.gm:
Continuity. FlickerStitch currently carries a Sectioned Stave of Soothe (Rank 2) (item 5, 410 gp) — a wand with one casting per day. This staff is its successor: charges instead of a single casting, soothe up to 3rd rank, and his two psi cantrips on tap.

Item 8 is above his current level 5. Fine for a signature NPC item, but if it should track his level, drop soothe to 2nd rank and it becomes item 6 at roughly 230 gp.

To make it sectioned as well, add the rune to the name and price: 700 gp total, still item 8.
description.value:
Two feet of driftwood ash off Junker's Edge, sanded pale by the sea and mended in four places with copper wire and boot-leather. FlickerStitch made it the way he was made: out of parts nobody wanted, stitched together, working anyway.

Every clear inch of the shaft is covered in tiny, painstaking goblin script — names, mostly, written small so that more will fit. He will tell you it is a list of everyone he has patched up. It is also a list of everyone he has decided to keep.

The brass cage at the head holds nothing at all. Whatever was set in it washed up somewhere else, or never existed; a pale light gathers there regardless when the staff is used — the same flicker that sits behind his eyes.

"Staff not magic. Staff is REMEMBERING. Flicker write down who not-die, and then they keep on not-dying. Is a system."

Activate Cast a Spell

Effect You expend a number of charges from the staff to cast a spell from its list.
